messages:
Carlos Diaz: Morning team, Carlos here  joined today as AE. Two quick blockers: no HubSpot/Gong access and I cant open the AE onboarding folder. Who should I tag for seats and wheres the short sandbox I can use to practice logging activities?

IT Ops: Welcome Carlos! Please paste this into the IT portal or submit a ticket with the snippet: 
```
product: Sales tools
requester: Carlos Diaz
email: carlos.diaz@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (Full seat), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Onboarding-2024, Sandbox CRM lead
priority: standard
needed-by: 2024-07-22
```
Reply here with the ticket ID and we'll follow up.

Carlos Diaz: Ticket created REQ-6102. Thanks! Also looking for the short discovery checklist and the objection cheat. Any quick links?

Jenna (sales ops): Hey Carlos  welcome! Canonical playbook is in Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Onboarding-2024. Shortchecks: "Discovery - 8 Qs" and "Objections - 3 phrases" are in QuickRefs. I can add you to the folder now. For sandbox, we keep a shared test lead called "AE Sandbox - 2024"  @Nia can spin one to your name.

Nia (CS): Ill create a sandbox lead and assign it to you in HubSpot once the seat is live. Also, for handoffs, use the "CS Handoff" template in Playbooks/Templates. If you want a 15-min run-through after youve shadowed, Ill give feedback on handoff clarity.

Carlos Diaz: REQ-6102 status shows "in progress". @IT Ops any ETA on the invites?

IT Ops: Should be done within a few hours. If SSO mapping fails we send direct invites. Ill update REQ-6102 here with invite links.

onboard-bot: Welcome Carlos Diaz! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/carlos_diaz_1745120000. Tasks added: Accept HubSpot invite, Watch Gong intro (10m), Shadow x2, Practice sandbox lead logging.

Jenna (sales ops): Quick Gong tip: enable noise reduction and auto-tag rules (Settings -> Call Tags) once you're in. We tag calls as discovery/demo/pricing. Also clone the "AE-Outbound" sequence from Sequences/shared-AE for your first week.

Carlos Diaz: Thanks  REQ-6102 updated: HubSpot seat granted, Gong invite sent. I got the invites and accepted. Can someone add me to the Drive folder?

Jenna (sales ops): Done  added you to /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Onboarding-2024. I also shared "Discovery - 8 Qs" and "Objections - 3 phrases" to your Drive. Let me know if you want the 12-min Gong intro recorded.

Nia (CS): Sandbox lead "AE Sandbox - Carlos" created and assigned. I dropped a note inside the lead with sample tasks: log call, add note, create CS handoff. Try logging one and ping me for a quick review.

Carlos Diaz: I logged the test activity and saw the auto-tag applied in Gong. Everything looks good. Appreciate the rapid help  excited to start shadowing later this week.

IT Ops: Closing REQ-6102 as resolved. Re-open if anything else pops up.

Jenna (sales ops): Welcome aboard Carlos! Friday 9:30 shadow + 20-min debrief on the calendar. We'll review two live discovery calls and the handoff flow. :tada:
